errors.evidence: The x-axis has evenly spaced tick marks (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, etc.), which indicates a linear scale, not a logarithmic one.

errors.text_span: 该线在x轴起始处（约0.0×10⁷）的Z-Score值约为0.5
errors.evidence: The line starts with a Z-score closer to 0, then immediately rises to a small peak of approximately 0.5 before dropping. Stating the starting value is 0.5 is an inaccurate simplification.
The minimum point of the curve is located at an x-value of approximately 0.16 x 10⁷, not 0.1 x 10⁷.
The peak of the curve is visibly above the 1.5 grid line; its Z-score is approximately 1.6, not 1.5.
The line exhibits a jagged, noisy texture throughout its entire length. It does not become smooth after the initial section.
